# RustSys

> RustSys is a high-performance Verilog/SystemVerilog synthesizer written in Rust, with a CLI built for engineers and agents. It maps RTL and a Liberty cell library to gate-level Verilog and structured reports. RustSys 0.1.0 is a source preview, not a crates.io release.

This is a navigation aid for agents, not a command protocol or an API guarantee.
The canonical site URL is configured as https://lab-emi.github.io/RustSys/;
deployment status must be checked separately. Web paths below are relative to
that site root. Source paths are relative to the repository root.

## Integration rules

- Use `rustsys --help` and `rusteda --help` from the installed build to confirm available commands.
- Keep standard output results separate from standard error diagnostics.
- Distinguish synthesis success, check equivalence, and undecided/budget-limited results.
- Use explicit file paths, proof budgets, thread counts, and workspace revision guards where applicable.
- Do not add reset/input assumptions to an arbitrary-initial-state proof without changing and reporting its scope.
- Benchmark timings, proof time, memory, and mapping quality are separate measurements.
- Do not infer placement/routing, signoff timing, DRC, or universal language support from synthesis results.
